design.data_family: strict MBO reconstruction, snapshot every 10 changed SendTime groups
design.initial_period: 2026-07-02 first 70% model fit / last 30% calibration only
design.direction_model: class-balanced multinomial logistic regression on 25 causal LOB features
design.drift: p(up)-p(down), linearly calibrated on prior OOS periods to expected 20-snapshot mid move in ticks

strategies.classic_as: finite-horizon AS closed-form quotes with prior-period variance and fill-decay estimates
strategies.gp_style_discrete: validation-tuned discrete tick/inventory approximation; not the original GP QVI solution
strategies.directional: GP-style discrete quote center plus calibrated directional drift
strategies.paired_no_signal: same directional parameters with signal strength forced to zero

execution.through: conservative proxy: later trade at least one tick beyond quote
execution.touch: optimistic proxy: later trade reaches quote

limitations: The first day's last 30% is calibration, so the primary PnL covers every later clean trading day rather than an in-sample first-day PnL.
A turnover yield is reported; an account return is undefined without user-specified capital, margin, short-borrow, and minimum-commission rules.
Touch/through are queue sensitivity assumptions because exact hypothetical queue position is unavailable.
The GP baseline is a practical discrete inventory approximation, not a numerical solution of the original Guilbaud-Pham QVI.
Market impact, queue-ahead volume, order acknowledgement/cancel latency beyond the fixed 5ms assumption, short-borrow costs, and broker minimum fees are omitted.
